results.description:
Foot Size Check measures feet with nothing but a sheet of A4 paper and a photo.

Kids' feet grow fast. Place a foot on A4 paper, trace around it with a pen, and photograph the sheet. The app reads the outline and measures foot length, width, and a suggested shoe size automatically. No points to line up by hand. The outline is kept at true size.

Features:
- A4-paper-based foot measurement (length and width)
- Automatic measurement: the traced line is read, heel, toe, and width points are placed for you, and length and width are calculated (you can still adjust by hand)
- Foot outline: the traced line is saved as a true-size shape
- Foot outline card: send it to family right after saving
- Suggested shoe size (foot length plus about 0.2 in of room, the recommended inside length)
- EU, US and UK conversion in the record detail, and the shoe size shown in your own notation (choose JP, EU, US or UK in Settings)
- Shoe size chart: switch between children, men and women to look up foot length against EU, US and UK
- Growth history saved over time
- Track left and right feet separately
- Fine-tune measurement points by hand
- Growth card: share the latest length, outline, and chart as one image with family
- Measurement reminder: at an interval that matches the age (every 3 months up to age 3, 4 months to age 6, 6 months from age 7; guidance from the Japanese Society of Podiatric Medicine)
- Birthday messages: add a birth date and get one quiet greeting that morning
- No account, no ads. Photos and records stay on your device (iCloud sync is optional, with Pro). The developer cannot read your data

Foot Size Check Pro (optional one-time purchase):
- Same-age reference band on the growth chart (by sex; published survey data from Japan, Spain, or China)
- Register more than one child (siblings; one is free)
- iCloud sync: records and outlines are saved to your own iCloud, come back after a new phone or reinstall, and appear on your other devices (photos stay on the device)
- Measuring, records, the chart, shoe notes, reminders, and birthday messages stay free. Not a subscription

Note: results are estimates only. Shoe fit varies by brand, model, and foot shape. We recommend measuring in person before buying shoes.
results.releaseNotes:
A maintenance release that makes your records safer.

- iCloud sync rebuilt: when the same record is edited on two devices, the newer edit wins. Records deleted during a sync no longer come back
- Fixed a bug where trace photos could be deleted if records failed to load
- Fixed a bug where a past record's shoe size changed as your child grew. The size is now based on the age at the time of the measurement
- Added FAQ entries on width grades and foot girth, including what grades like 2E mean and how to measure girth
- Clarified that photo correction only flattens distortion of the paper surface

results.description:
DailyAlbum keeps one photo a day and hangs it in a frame. A spare iPhone or iPad, or your TV, becomes the frame that shows today's photo.

Use it for family moments, kids' growth, pets, trips, everyday life, plants, creative work, or any small change worth remembering. Open a date, choose one meaningful photo, and let your saved days fill in — no photo editing or social feeds getting in the way. Empty days can even fill themselves: DailyAlbum quietly suggests one good photo — favoring people and pets, skipping screenshots and document shots — all on your device.

◆ Display it
Frame Mode shows today's photo full screen with its date and note. Stand up an iPad or an old iPhone and it becomes a family photo frame. At the start of each month, replay last month as a monthly album.

◆ Never lose it
Turn on iCloud Sync (free, optional) and your photo choices and notes are stored in your personal iCloud, so they survive a new phone or a reinstall. Notes hold up to 300 characters, and you can search them to find that day again in seconds.

◆ Revisit and share
Add the widget to meet a saved moment on your home screen, and get a gentle note when a photo from this day in past years exists. Turn any day into a beautiful card — photo, date, and note — to share in messages or social apps.

◆ Share it with family (DailyAlbum Family)
With the DailyAlbum Family subscription, invited family can view your days in DailyAlbum — one photo per day, like a photo frame in their home. You choose exactly what to share: all daily photos, or only days with a tag you pick. It's view-only, always free for the family you invite, and you can see when they last looked. All Plus features are included while the subscription is active.

◆ Privacy
No account is required. By default DailyAlbum shows photos straight from your photo library and doesn't upload them. With iCloud Sync on, your choices and notes are stored in your personal iCloud. If you turn on photo sync (Plus) or share with family (Family), a copy of just those photos is kept in your own iCloud too — never on the developer's servers, and never readable by the developer.

DailyAlbum Plus (a one-time purchase) adds DailyAlbum Archive (a copy of each chosen photo saved inside the app, for steadier and faster viewing), unlimited Frame Mode, unlimited monthly album replays, and multi-device sync. The calendar, photo picking, notes, iCloud Sync, and note search stay free.

DailyAlbum Family is an auto-renewing subscription (monthly or yearly). Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, and the subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings. Viewing is always free for invited family.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://zec-inc.jp/privacy
results.releaseNotes:
Fixed cases where, when using DailyAlbum on more than one device, a photo or note you changed could revert, or a day you removed could come back.

Fixed a case where, after changing a day's photo on another device, the old photo could keep showing.

Fixed a case where deleting a tag you were sharing with family left already-shared photos on their side. While sharing, changes to the sharing scope now take effect with "Apply Sharing Scope".

Fixed a case where, depending on the connection, a purchase could be treated as not purchased.

Widget photos now keep their full color on tinted Home Screens.

Added "How do I turn an old iPhone or iPad into a photo frame?" to the FAQ, and rewrote the explanation of where photos are stored so it is accurate for each feature.

results.description:
DoneToday helps you keep one daily habit with a single tap.

No task lists. No planning overload. Name your one thing, tap Done once a day, and see your streak and calendar fill up.

DoneToday is designed to be simple:

- One task at a time, one tap to mark it done
- Current streak, best streak, and a monthly calendar
- Home Screen widget with a Done button
- Lock Screen widgets and a Control Center toggle (iOS 18)
- Siri and Shortcuts: "Mark done in DoneToday"
- Optional daily reminder that stays quiet once today is done
- Forgot yesterday? Mark it from the calendar or the one-line prompt

No account. No cloud. Your history stays on your device.

Made by ZEC — simple tools for everyday life.
results.releaseNotes:
- Medium Home Screen widget with the last 7 days and a Done button
- Share this month as an image from the calendar
- Small fixes

results.description:
Big Text Note is a simple local note app for showing one memo in large, easy-to-read text.

Show what you type or dictate directly to the person in front of you. Big Text Note works as a simple communication board for talking with someone who is deaf or hard of hearing, leaving a message for an older family member, or getting a point across in a noisy place.

Speak a note with voice input, type directly, or edit the text by hand. Voice input converts speech into text, then you choose whether to append the result to your note or replace the current note. This app does not save audio files. Only text you apply to the note is saved locally.

Use Show mode when you want the note to act like a clear message board. Choose Normal, Large, or Huge text presets, fine-tune the size, and set text and background colors in Settings. The larger sizes are especially useful on iPad.

Add the Home Screen widget to keep your current note visible at a glance. The widget reads the same note, text size, and colors as the app through private App Group storage.

No account is required. There are no ads, no tracking, and no server sync.
results.releaseNotes: Version 1.2.7 shows Quick Phrases in a half-height sheet so you can pick one while still seeing your note, and fixes an issue where the keyboard Done button sometimes did not appear.

results.description:
Mute Video Before Share removes the audio track from a video so you can share it without background voices, conversations, or noise.

Pick a video, tap once, and get a silent copy. Because the audio is removed without re-encoding the video, the picture quality stays exactly the same and even long videos finish fast.

Features:
- Remove all sound from a video in one tap
- No quality loss: the video track is copied as-is, not re-encoded
- No length limit
- No watermark
- The silent copy contains no location or camera metadata from the original
- Your original video stays unchanged
- No account, no upload, no ads, no tracking - everything runs on your device

Perfect before posting to social media: mute background conversations, wind noise, or anything you would rather keep private.
results.releaseNotes: A refreshed look: calm teal design, a clearer three-step flow (Choose, Mute, Save & Share), and a Silent badge on the preview that confirms the audio is gone.

results.description:
BaroNote is a simple barometer and personal log.

Check the current air pressure, see whether it is rising, steady, or falling, and save a quick private note about your mood and condition.

Features:

- Current air pressure display using the iPhone pressure sensor when available
- Rising, steady, and falling trend display
- Mood and condition logs
- Symptom tags and optional notes
- History list
- hPa, mb, inHg, and mmHg units
- Home Screen widgets
- Lock Screen accessory widgets on supported iOS versions
- Local-only storage
- No account, tracking, ads, or server upload

BaroNote is for personal logging only and does not provide medical advice.
results.releaseNotes:
A fresh new design. BaroNote now wears a calm "after the rain" look: the current pressure is bigger and easier to read, and the trend shows at a glance with color.

- Home: redesigned pressure card with clear rising/falling colors
- History: symptom tags are now easy-to-scan chips
- Widgets match the new design

Your notes still stay only on this device.

results.description:
OCR Copy is a local-first OCR utility for quickly copying text from camera, live scan, and photos.

Use live scan, take a photo, or pick an image from Photos to read text and copy it right away. You can edit or remove only the lines you need while keeping the original OCR result.

Saved text stays on your device so you can return to it and copy it again later. OCR language settings are available when Auto does not read the text well.

Confidence and text position are detail information, not accuracy scores. Photos and text are not sent to an external server. Processing and storage stay on device.
results.releaseNotes: Minor improvements and fixes.

results.description:
Sheep to Sleep turns the classic bedtime ritual of counting sheep into a quiet companion for winding down.

- Sheep counted aloud for you — just listen, no need to watch the screen
- A gentle breathing guide to settle down before bed
- A sleep timer that stops automatically
- No account, no ads

The screen stays awake while counting; locking the screen stops the voice. A calm way to end the day.
results.releaseNotes:
A quiet design refresh.
- Warm night-light colors and a soft new sheep illustration
- The screen gently dims while counting, so it never keeps you up
- Clearer text and layout for tired eyes

results.description:
Study Buddy Timer is a simple focus timer for tracking your study time.

Start a study session with one tap, stop when you are done, and keep track of your daily study time, sessions, EXP, and level progress.

You can also check your study progress from Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, so your daily study time is always easy to see.

Study Pair (Study Buddy Pro)
Connect with one partner through an invite link and see their study time for today and whether they are studying right now.
Grow one buddy with the time you both put in. Days when both of you show up are "pair days". Days when only one of you studies grow the buddy half as much.
Choose a "cheer" role instead of studying. A parent can take part with one tap a day, which makes Study Pair a gentle way to support a child.
Only study-time totals are shared. Session times and notes never leave your device. Pair data lives only in your iCloud, and the developer cannot see it.
Only the person who creates the pair needs Pro (one-time purchase). Invited partners join for free.

Features:
- One-tap study timer
- Daily study time tracking
- Study session count
- EXP and level progress
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
- Simple stats screen
- Study Pair: see your partner's study time, grow one buddy together, cheer role
- Data stored on your device (pairs sync through your iCloud)

It is not a complex task manager. It is a lightweight study timer for people who want to start studying and keep going.
results.releaseNotes:
New: Study Pair (Study Buddy Pro).
- Connect with one partner through an invite link and see their study time for today and whether they are studying right now.
- Grow one buddy with the time you both put in. Days when both of you show up count as "pair days" and grow the buddy the most.
- Choose a "cheer" role instead of studying, so parents can support a child without tracking them.
- The Home Screen widget can show your partner's study time for today.
- Pair data lives only in your iCloud. The developer cannot see it.
Only the person who creates the pair needs Pro (one-time purchase). Invited partners join for free.
Also fixes the buddy's smile and localizes the default buddy name.

results.description:
Never wonder “Did I do the laundry?” again.

Laundry Tap shows you exactly how long it’s been since your last wash — and when it’s time to do it again.

No lists. No clutter. Just one tap.

■ See your laundry status instantly
Fresh, OK, or Time to wash — your current state is clear at a glance.

■ One-tap reset
Did the laundry? Just tap once and reset your status to fresh.

■ Stay on track without thinking
Set a reminder and never let laundry pile up again.

■ Simple by design
No categories. No complex setup. Just what you need.

Laundry Tap turns a small daily stress into a simple habit.
results.releaseNotes:
- A fresh, cleaner design across Home, History, and Settings.
- New: Light Mode support — the app now follows your system appearance.

results.description:
CleanURL Tap turns long, messy URLs into short clean links you can share.

Copied links from shops, news sites, and social apps often carry a long tail of tracking and campaign parameters after the "?". Open CleanURL Tap and it detects the URL on your clipboard, strips the junk, and hands you a short clean link. Copy it or share it right away.

WHEN IT HELPS
- A link you want to send is too long and unreadable
- You want to share Amazon or Rakuten product links without the clutter
- You want clean URLs in notes, documents, or posts
- You prefer to remove tracking parameters before sharing

WHAT IT DOES
- Just open the app: clipboard URLs are detected and cleaned automatically
- Normalizes Amazon product links to the short /dp/ form
- Understands Rakuten and other popular marketplace links
- Removes UTM campaign tags, ad click IDs, affiliate tags, and social share noise
- Share extension: clean links straight from the share sheet, without opening the app
- Optional mode to remove everything after "?"
- Every cleanup rule can be switched on or off
- Product options such as color and size are preserved so links keep working

PRIVACY
Everything happens on your device. No account, no link history, and URLs are never uploaded anywhere.
results.releaseNotes:
A cleaner look for a cleaner link:
- Redesigned main screen: the cleaned URL is now front and center
- See exactly which tracking parameters were removed, right in the app
- Copy is now the primary action, with a clearer confirmation
- The share extension matches the new design
- Better layout on iPad
- Fixed the removal summary appearing in English on non-English devices

results.description:
Don't read the forecast. Get the answer.

Today Ready turns the weather into the four calls you actually make every morning — umbrella, laundry, outfit, and outdoor plans — and shows the conclusion first.

Use Today Ready to check:

- Whether to bring an umbrella
- Whether a light jacket helps
- Whether laundry is better indoors
- Whether outdoor plans are easier earlier

Check items off when you are ready. Today's checks stay for the day and reset the next day.

The widget keeps the first answer visible from your Home Screen, with a short prep conclusion and today's weather summary.

Today Ready keeps things simple. It does not require an account, does not show ads, and does not track you.

Weather data may be provided through Apple Weather/WeatherKit or Open-Meteo depending on availability.
results.releaseNotes: Refined home screen design: clearer hierarchy with the day's conclusion first, and full support for your preferred text size (Dynamic Type).

results.description:
PillTap helps you avoid missed doses with simple daily medication reminders.

Set your medication times once, and PillTap will remind you every day at the times you choose. Marking a dose as taken is optional and used only for your own record. Reminders continue to repeat unless you turn off a scheduled time or delete the medication.

PillTap is designed to be simple:

- Daily medication reminders at morning, noon, night, and bedtime
- Optional follow-up reminder 15 minutes later
- One tap to mark a dose as taken, right from the notification
- Lock Screen widget showing your next dose
- Live Activity shortly before it is time
- Time Sensitive reminders that can appear during Sleep or other Focus modes, based on your iOS settings
- Recent history (today, yesterday, last 7 days)

No account. No cloud. Your medications and records stay on your device.

PillTap does not provide medical advice, assess conditions, or recommend how to take medication. Always follow instructions from your doctor, pharmacist, or healthcare provider.
results.releaseNotes:
- Optional follow-up reminder 15 minutes after each dose time
- Japanese language support
- Refreshed design with Light Mode support
- Settings now include support, privacy, and version information

results.description:
WaterDone is the lightest way to keep sipping before you get thirsty.

Had a sip? Tap once. That's the whole app.
No amounts to type. No daily target. The goal is a rhythm: another sip within the interval you choose. A little drop dries out as time passes and fills up when you drink, and a gentle word tells you how you're doing — "Hydrated", "Time for a sip".

• One tap from your Lock Screen or Home Screen widget, without opening the app
• See when your next sip is due, right on the home screen
• A gentle nudge before you dry out. You pick the interval (2–4 hours) and the hours it can reach you. Works fine with notifications off, too
• Tapped by mistake? Undo in one tap
• A streak and a simple calendar of every sip
• No account. Everything stays on your device

Hydration that doesn't feel like homework.
WaterDone is not medical advice and does not calculate how much water you need.
results.releaseNotes:
A sip before you're thirsty — and a softer, friendlier WaterDone.

• See when your next sip is due
• Gentle nudges before you dry out (pick the interval and active hours in Settings)
• The "I had a sip" button is now a water drop that dries out over time and fills when you drink
• Undo a mistaken tap
• Light and Dark Mode, gentler wording

results.description:
Packed is a simple packing checklist for the things you need to bring today.

Create a group for a trip, school bag, gym visit, hospital stay, your child's daily items, or any repeat routine. Add the items once, then check what is ready before you leave.

Features:
- Manage packing groups and item lists
- Check today's packed state at a glance
- Mark a whole group packed in one tap
- Set reminder days and times per group
- See today's progress in a widget
- No account required
- No external server sync

Packed keeps the workflow light: open the app, check the list, and leave with fewer forgotten items.
results.releaseNotes:
A fresh look for Packed:
- Dark Mode support — the app now follows your system appearance
- Refined design with better readability and larger text support
- Gentle haptics when you finish packing
- Confirmation before deleting a group
Under the hood: faster daily check loading and automatic cleanup of old check records. Your lists and today's checks are unchanged.

results.description:
PinLog is a simple place to save text and links you do not want to lose.

Save a note, paste from the clipboard, import a file, or send content from another app through the share sheet. PinLog keeps the item clean and ready, then helps you return to it later from the app or Home Screen widget.

Use it for launch notes, links to read, product ideas, checklist fragments, reminders, and small pieces of text that are useful but easy to forget.

Features:
- Save text and links quickly
- Dictate notes with voice input
- Import text, Markdown, and JSON files
- Save from other apps with the share extension
- Open URL pins in the browser
- Tap links inside notes from the detail view
- Use a widget to resurface saved items
- Copy, edit, share, or delete saved pins

PinLog is intentionally small: no feeds, no folders to manage, and no complicated note system. It is built for capturing something now and acting on it later.
results.releaseNotes: A refreshed design: a deeper dark canvas, a sharper lime accent, and smoother rounded cards. Saving now confirms with a subtle haptic tap, and the share extension matches the app's look. Plus small fixes and polish throughout.

results.description:
Track your day in one tap.

TapLog is a simple mood tracker designed for speed and clarity.
No typing. No thinking. Just tap.

Log how you feel in seconds and look back on your days with a clean, minimal calendar.

Features:
- One-tap mood logging
- Simple and intuitive interface
- Calendar view of your mood history
- No account required

Stay aware. Stay consistent.
results.releaseNotes: Internal improvements: a smaller, cleaner app binary and an updated App Store privacy manifest. No changes to how you log your mood.

results.description:
PoopTap is a one-tap poop tracker with a twist: every log feeds a weird little poop buddy that grows, evolves, and slowly develops opinions about your gut habits.

Tap once after you go. That's the whole workflow. Your log lands on a private calendar, your streak grows, and your poop evolves through stages — from Tiny Poop all the way to Legendary. The Throne Keeper watches over your record and comments on your progress, whether you asked or not.

Under the humor is a genuinely useful bowel movement log: shape and color details, a short note per entry, a monthly calendar view, and optional reminders when your record goes quiet. A home and lock screen widget lets you log without opening the app.

Progress is designed to reward consistency, not spam: only a limited daily growth bonus counts toward evolution.

Everything stays on your device. No accounts, no ads, no analytics. PoopTap is for personal tracking and entertainment — it is not a medical app and does not provide health advice.

PoopTap Plus (one-time purchase) unlocks extra evolution forms, premium trivia, extra achievements, premium share cards, Annoying reminder mode, themes, and optional iCloud Backup & Restore.
results.releaseNotes: A tiny housekeeping update: we made the App Store screenshots easier to read and did some polishing behind the scenes. Your logs, streaks, and throne are untouched.

results.description:
Body Rhythm Log is a simple and private way to track your personal patterns.

No streaks. No pressure. Just log and move on.

• Log events with a single tap
• View your history in a clean calendar
• Stay aware of your own rhythm over time
• Minimal design, no distractions
• Fully private, no accounts required

This app is designed for quiet, personal use.
No goals, no pressure—just your rhythm.

Hong Kong Phrase Card is a practical travel phrase card app for Japanese travelers visiting Hong Kong.

Search phrases in Japanese, English, or Cantonese/Traditional Chinese, then show large Traditional Chinese text to local people. When visual communication is not enough, you can play speech using the iPhone text-to-speech system.

The app includes 160 offline phrases for common travel situations such as airports, hotels, transportation, taxis, trains, restaurants, cafes, shopping, convenience stores, sightseeing, payment, illness, allergies, trouble, and emergencies. It is designed mainly for Hong Kong travel and may also help in places where Cantonese or Traditional Chinese is useful.

Features:

- Search in Japanese, English, and Cantonese/Traditional Chinese
- 160 offline travel phrases
- Large Traditional Chinese Show mode
- English text shown together
- Katakana pronunciation guides for Japanese travelers
- Speech playback support
- Favorites
- Category lists ordered by practical usefulness rank
- Works offline
- No account and no external translation API

Use it when you need a quick phrase that is easier to show than to type into a live translation app.

Note: This app is intended to support simple travel communication. For emergencies, medical, legal, immigration, or official matters, please confirm with local authorities or qualified professionals.
results.releaseNotes: Phrases now play out loud even when your iPhone is set to silent, so you can let locals hear the Cantonese audio anytime.

results.description:
年齢プロフィールは、家族や親族の生年月日をまとめて管理できる日本向けのプロフィール帳アプリです。

父母、祖父母、子ども、親族などのプロフィールを保存して、満年齢、数え年、生年月日の和暦、今年の和暦、干支、星座、一般的な厄年の目安、長寿祝いをひと目で確認できます。

「おじいちゃんは今年何歳？」「厄年っていつ？」「還暦のお祝いは何年？」――家族の記念日まわりの確認が、このアプリひとつで終わります。

主な使い方:
- 家族・親族のプロフィールを登録して、年齢・和暦・干支・星座を一覧で確認
- 誕生日や長寿祝い（還暦、古希、喜寿など）の通知を設定
- 西暦・和暦変換ツールで、明治、大正、昭和、平成、令和の年月日を変換。履歴書、申請書、役所手続きの確認にも便利

安心してお使いいただけます:
- プロフィール、メモ、通知設定はすべて端末内に保存
- アカウント登録不要、広告なし、外部送信なし

無料版ではプロフィールを2件まで保存できます。買い切りのPlusを購入すると、プロフィール保存数が無制限になります。

このアプリは占い、運勢、災厄、健康効果などを断定するものではありません。厄年や長寿祝いは、一般的な目安として表示しています。
results.releaseNotes:
デザインを全面的に刷新しました。

- 年齢と節目の年がひと目でわかる新しいプロフィール画面
- 一覧を見やすく整理。次の長寿祝いや厄年の目安がすぐわかります
- 和暦・西暦変換の結果を大きく見やすく表示
- 保存や日付確定時の手応え（ハプティクス）を改善
results.trackCensoredName: 年齢プロフィール - 和暦・厄年・数え年
results.trackName: 年齢プロフィール - 和暦・厄年・数え年

results.description:
AssetCurve is a local, simple compound-growth simulator for creating rough estimates from your own inputs.

Use Future Value mode to estimate a possible future asset amount from an initial amount, monthly contribution, expected annual return, and number of years. Use Goal Backsolve mode to estimate the monthly contribution that would be needed for a target amount under the same simplified assumptions.

The app shows future value, total contributions, estimated growth, a monthly chart, and a yearly projection. USD is the default unit, with JPY and EUR also available.

AssetCurve is not investment advice and does not recommend any investment. Results are approximate simulations only and do not guarantee future outcomes. Taxes, fees, currency changes, market volatility, asset allocation, correlation, and other real-world factors are not included.

No account, cloud sync, external API, or network connection is required.
results.releaseNotes:
- Cleaner, more consistent design with unified colors, spacing, and card styles
- Improved Light and Dark Mode consistency
- Calculations are unchanged

results.description:
Silly Word Beat turns three word cards into a silly combo sequence,
read out loud by a serious textbook-style voice. The gap between the
plain sentences and the nonsense words is the whole joke.

HOW IT WORKS
- Pick a sound group: Pop, Tap, or Click.
- Choose three word cards: a Base word, Word A, and Word B.
- Preview the eight generated lines.
- Tap Read and listen to the combo in a steady rhythm.
- Shuffle picks a ready-made three-word set for you.

EVERY GROUP HAS ITS OWN BEAT
- Pop Words: "I have a/an ..." with a big "Boom!"
- Tap Words: "This is a/an ..." with a happy "Ta-da!"
- Click Words: "I like a/an ..." with a crisp "Click!"

GREAT FOR
- Laughing together over made-up words
- Playing with English sounds and simple sentences
- Quick fun with no setup and no reading required

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account. No ads. No tracking.
- No microphone. Speech is generated on your device.
- Works completely offline.
results.releaseNotes: New app name and a refreshed App Store page. Small internal improvements.

results.description:
UndoCam turns short videos into simple rewind clips.

Choose a video under 15 seconds, reverse it, then save or share. It is made for quick everyday clips, funny moments, and social posts.

Videos are processed on your device. No account, no upload, no complicated editing.

Access Lens helps you view everyday scenes and photos through simplified visual awareness filters. Use the live camera preview or choose a photo, then try blur, low contrast, cataract-style, tunnel vision, and central blind spot effects to notice how text, signs, layouts, and visual details can become harder to read.

The app is designed for awareness, education, and accessibility checks. It is not a medical diagnosis app, does not provide medical advice, and does not accurately reproduce any visual condition. The filters are simplified simulations for learning and discussion.

Features:

- Live camera preview
- Photo import from the system photo picker
- Blur, cataract-style, tunnel, central spot, and low contrast filters
- Adjustable filter intensity
- Normal / Filtered comparison
- Save filtered images to Photos only when you choose
- Share filtered images with the system share sheet
- Local processing on device

Access Lens does not collect personal data, does not use analytics or advertising SDKs, and does not upload images to external servers.

Number Forge is a daily number puzzle. Every day brings one new
puzzle: combine six numbers with + - x / to forge the target number.

HOW TO PLAY
- Pick two tiles and an operation to forge them into a new number.
- Reach the target in as few operations as you can.
- Par shows the minimum possible. Can you match it?

ONE PUZZLE A DAY
- Everyone gets the same puzzle each day.
- Track solved days, your current streak, longest streak, and par matches.
- Share your result as spoiler-free text.

DAILY LEADERBOARD
- Solved today? See where you stand: "Today: #N of M" on the Game Center Daily Forge leaderboard.
- Scores start at 2,000: each move over par costs 200 points and each second costs 1 (time stops counting at 20 minutes).
- Game Center sign-in is optional. Everything works without it.

WIDGET AND REMINDER
- Add a widget to see today's target, or your solved result, at a glance.
- An optional daily reminder helps you keep the habit. The app works
  fully without notifications.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account required. No ads. No tracking.
- Your progress stays on your device.
results.releaseNotes:
The leaderboard is a straight score now:
• 2,000 points to start. Each move over par costs 200, each second costs 1 (time stops at 20 minutes).
• Higher is better, and the ranking is a plain number instead of a time.
• The clock only runs while the app is open, so putting the puzzle down no longer costs you.
• Your score is front and center on the solved card and in the shared text.
• Today's ranking moves to a new board, so scores start fresh.

results.description:
Korean Travel Phrase Card is a practical travel phrase card app for Japanese travelers visiting Korea.

You do not need to memorize Korean. Search for a phrase in Japanese, show large Korean text to a local person, or play Korean speech using the iPhone text-to-speech system.

The app includes 96 offline phrases for common travel situations such as restaurants, cafes, shopping, cosmetics and beauty, hotels, transportation, payment, photo requests, fan events, health, allergies, and trouble.

Features:

- Search in Japanese, English, and Korean
- 96 offline travel phrases
- Large Korean Show mode
- Korean speech playback support
- Katakana reading guides for Japanese travelers
- Favorites
- Category lists ordered by practical usefulness rank
- Works offline
- No account
- No ads or in-app purchases
- No personal data collection
- No external translation API

Use it when you need a quick phrase that is easier to show than to type into a live translation app.

Note: This app is intended to support simple travel communication. Katakana readings are approximate aids, not precise pronunciation. For emergencies, medical, legal, immigration, or official matters, please confirm with local authorities or qualified professionals.
results.releaseNotes:
A full design refresh.

- Phrase detail now shows the Korean text and reading first, in a large card
- Show Mode is now the primary button, and the screen stays awake while showing a phrase
- Added helpful guidance when a search or filter has no results
- Adding a favorite now responds with a gentle haptic
- Refined colors and improved Dark Mode readability

results.description:
Cute Privacy Stamp hides faces and private details in photos with cute stamps.

Before posting kids' photos to social media, pick a stamp - hearts, stars, cats, sparkles - and place it over what you want to hide. Unlike blur or mosaic, stamps keep the photo cheerful and cute.

Features:
- Cute stamps for hiding faces: hearts, sparkles, stars, cats, and more
- Eye-bar stamps and larger covers
- Move and resize stamps freely
- Easy undo and delete
- Saved copies contain no location metadata from the original
- Your original photo stays unchanged
- No account, no upload, no ads, no tracking - everything runs on your device
results.releaseNotes:
- Refreshed design: a soft sakura canvas with a unified strawberry accent
- Stamps now land with a playful "petta" bounce and a gentle haptic
- Improved toast readability, especially in Dark Mode

results.description:
ごはんスナップは、食べたものを写真だけで残す、ゆるい食事記録アプリです。

カロリー計算はしません。栄養の判定もしません。広告もアカウントもありません。写真を撮って、朝食・昼食・夕食・間食のタグを選ぶだけ。カレンダーが食事の写真で少しずつ埋まっていきます。

■ できること
- 写真で食事を記録: カメラまたはライブラリから1タップ
- 食事タイプのタグ: 朝食・昼食・夕食・間食
- ひとことメモ: 「野菜多め」「外食」など、ひとことだけ添えられます
- 写真で埋まるカレンダー: 記録した日は、その日の写真がカレンダーに並びます
- 月間サマリー: 記録日数・食事タイプの内訳・連続記録を月ごとに振り返り
- ホーム画面ウィジェット: 今日の記録数と連続記録、最近の写真をホーム画面でひと目で確認
- 食事リマインダー: 朝・昼・夜の好きな時刻に通知でお知らせ(初期設定はすべてオフ)
- 連続記録とバッジ: 続けるのがちょっと楽しくなる、ゆるいごほうび
- AIに相談: 記録をコピーしてお使いのAIアプリに貼り付け、食事の相談ができます(アプリ内にAIは搭載していません)

■ 大切にしていること
- 記録はすべて端末の中だけ。外部送信はありません
- 数えない、責めない。写真が残っているだけで十分
- アカウント不要・広告なし・無料

「食事管理アプリは続かなかったけど、何を食べたかは残しておきたい」。そんな人のための、いちばん身軽な食事フォトログです。

※本アプリは健康・栄養に関する助言を行うものではありません。
results.releaseNotes: ごはんスナップの最初のバージョンです。写真とタグ、ひとことメモのゆるい食事記録を、写真で埋まるカレンダー・月間サマリー・ホーム画面ウィジェット・食事リマインダーで楽しく続けられます。

results.description:
Caffeine Tap is a simple caffeine tracker built for quick daily logging.

Tap coffee, tea, espresso, cola, or energy drinks to record your caffeine intake. See your daily total, your remaining amount, and a simple cutoff reminder for later in the day.

No account. No complicated charts. Just a lightweight caffeine log for everyday use.

Features:

- One tap caffeine logging
- Daily caffeine total
- Remaining caffeine amount
- Custom caffeine amount
- Small Home Screen Widget
- Cutoff reminder
- Personal daily limit
- Local storage only

Caffeine amounts are estimates and may vary by brand, size, and brewing method. Caffeine Tap is for personal tracking only and does not provide medical advice.
results.releaseNotes:
Log a cup without opening the app: the home screen widget now has a "Log 1 cup" button that records your default drink instantly.

Your day's total updates right away when you come back to the app.

results.description:
ClipMD turns web pages and copied text into clean Markdown clips you keep on your device.

Paste a URL or share a page to ClipMD, and it extracts the article body and converts it to Markdown - headings, lists, and links included. Copy the result into your notes app, or keep it in ClipMD as a reading archive.

Features:
- Convert web pages to Markdown by URL or from the share sheet
- Convert copied text in one tap
- Clean extraction focused on the article body
- Copy, share, edit, or delete any clip
- Clips are stored locally on your device
- Network access is used only to fetch pages you explicitly request
- No account, no telemetry, no ads, no tracking

Made for note-takers who live in Markdown: clip it now, paste it anywhere later.

ExifOff checks what a photo reveals and creates a clean copy for safer sharing.

Pick a photo to see whether it contains location data, plus basics like date, camera, size, and file type. Then create a new JPEG copy with the metadata removed. Your original photo is never changed.

Features:
- See whether location data is found before you share
- Check date, camera, image size, and file type
- Create a clean JPEG copy with metadata removed
- Clean up to 50 photos at once
- Clean straight from the share sheet: share photos from any app and get clean copies back
- Save or share the clean copies
- Originals stay untouched
- No account, no upload, no tracking - everything runs on your device

Note: ExifOff creates new clean copies for sharing. It does not edit or delete your original photos.
results.releaseNotes: Refreshed design: a cleaner look with a new green accent, clearer metadata warnings, and a more reassuring "clean copy created" confirmation. Photo processing is unchanged — everything stays on your device.

results.description:
Blur Before Share hides faces, names, IDs, and anything else you do not want to share, right before you share it.

Draw with your finger over the parts to hide. Choose the effect that fits:

- Blur: soften faces and backgrounds
- Mosaic: irreversible pixelation for text, plates, and IDs
- Black: fully opaque cover for anything sensitive

The saved copy is re-rendered from scratch, so it contains no location data or camera information from the original photo. Your original stays unchanged.

Features:
- Three effects: blur, mosaic, black
- Mix effects in one photo
- Undo and reset while editing
- Saved copies contain no EXIF or GPS metadata
- Original photo is never modified
- No account, no upload, no ads, no tracking - everything runs on your device

Use it before posting screenshots, kids' photos, tickets, documents, or anything with personal information.
results.releaseNotes:
- Fixed an issue where the blur could appear away from where you touched, especially on photos taken with the camera.
- Refreshed design: clearer first screen, easier-to-find Save and Share buttons, and a subtle haptic each time a stroke lands.
- You can now pick a different photo without restarting the app.
